title: W0 Run Authorization
description: Closed run-specific authority obtained during the pinned bootstrap VALIDATE→ADMIT interval, after W0 postexecution PASS and before any assigned-worker/project/Studio/network implementation side effect. Exact authority-monitored external temp, challenge, and proof writes performed by PREPARE/VALIDATE are bootstrap operations, not product authority. The project/package/B2/WP lock remains continuous. This authorization and every presentation/challenge/transcript/statement/capture/PV artifact are written only to predeclared operator-external absolute paths outside the locked project/package/baseline trees; any project-local authorization evidence path is invalid. pathScope.frozenPaths is not operator-selected: the receiver mechanically derives and exact-compares the complete immutable project-path set reachable from the validated W0 package, while allowedWritePaths remains identity- and containment-disjoint from that set. assignedReceiver binds both the complete installed receiver Skill tree and the human-approved expected loaded-process closure before the human responds; no actual worker observation is claimed until the post-semantic signed ADMIT execution receipt. scopeCoreSha256 hashes exactly the pre-response scopeCore object with UTF-8 json.dumps(scopeCore, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Response-derived authorization id/actor/channel/message/authorizedAt and evidence refs are outside that digest and are bound by the standard presentation→challenge→human transcript/statement→capture→offline pinned-signature provenance chain. A later continuous-lock w0_run_admission_attestation is still mandatory.

approvalEvidence.description: All six artifacts are distinct and rehashed. Presentation of the full target/scope precedes the canonical human response; challenge nonce and every interaction/message ID are globally non-reused. Capture and PV exact-match scopeCoreSha256.

operatorExternalAbsolutePath.description: Absolute operator-external evidence/control path outside resolvedProjectRoot, every baseline snapshot, the W0 package tree, the installed creator/validator Skill, the assigned receiver Skill tree, and runtime temp. Semantic validation resolves aliases and rejects any containment, symlink, junction, reparse, mount, hardlink identity alias, or path escape into a protected tree.

receiverSkillAbsolutePath.description: Absolute installed assigned-receiver Skill entrypoint path inside the receiver Skill tree bound by receiverSkillTreeSha256. It must remain outside resolvedProjectRoot, every B0/B1/B2 snapshot, the W0 package tree, the installed creator/validator Skill, runtime temp, and every operator-external authorization/evidence root. Semantic validation resolves aliases/identities and rejects symlink, junction, reparse, mount, hardlink alias, or path escape.

projectPath.description: Normalized project-relative POSIX path. Windows device basenames, dot/parent segments, backslashes, duplicate separators, and a segment ending in dot are invalid; semantic validation additionally requires one case-folded resolved identity with no alias or containment ambiguity.

allowedWritePaths.description: Exact authorized write paths. Semantic validation resolves Windows aliases and identities and rejects every exact, case-insensitive, ancestor, descendant, or identity overlap with frozenPaths.

frozenPaths.description: Exact Unicode-ordinal-sorted, normalized project-relative set mechanically rederived from the validated W0 package and current package path: B0/B1/B2 manifest paths; every physical snapshot member at revision.snapshotRoot/files[].path; the W0 package itself; and every project-local handoff/proof artifact transitively reachable through package and referenced JSON evidence. Missing or extra paths, aliases, non-canonical Windows names, symlinks/junctions/reparse points, hardlinks or other file-identity aliases, and operator-selected substitutions fail closed. Every immutable snapshot member must be an independent link-count-1 regular file.

pathScope.description: The receiver derives frozenPaths before presentation and exact-compares it again at ADMIT. allowedWritePaths must remain disjoint from the derived immutable set under resolved Windows path, containment, and file-identity semantics.

receiverSkillTreeSha256.description: Human-approved SHA-256 of canonical JSON {files:[...]} for the exact installed receiver Skill root containing skill.path. files is the Unicode-ordinal-sorted unique closed set of every regular file as {path,bytes,sha256}, using relative POSIX paths and UTF-8 json.dumps(..., ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')). Missing, extra, symlink, junction, reparse, mount, special, escape, or identity-aliased entries fail. skill.sha256 separately binds the receiver Skill entrypoint bytes.

expectedLoadedProcessClosureSha256.description: Human-approved expected digest for the complete receiver process closure eligible to load, including the selected tool/host executable, modules, DLL/shared libraries, helpers, and receiver Skill tree. No assigned worker may be launched before ADMIT semantic PASS. After that PASS, the authority launches the worker suspended/pre-entry under scope enforcement and records an independently observed actualLoadedProcessClosureSha256 in the signed ADMIT execution receipt; it must equal this expected digest byte-for-byte before bootstrap PASS or any product effect. An unobserved, missing, extra, or substituted component fails closed.
